text:
```yaml
name: Check dist changes

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  check-dist:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check for dist changes
        run: |
          echo "Checking for changes in dist/"
          if git diff --name-only ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }} ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }} | grep -q '^dist/'; then
            echo "dist/ changes detected. Failing the workflow."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "No dist/ changes detected."
          fi
        shell: bash
```
